#midterms #senate #republicans #democrats There are so many elections that could swing to Republicans or Democrats in this Midterm Election, but I am particularly interested in what’s going to happen in the United States Senate. Two years ago, it was unthinkable that the Democrats could pull off a Senate power flip. But today, all bets are off!

There are NINE Senate races on Tuesday’s ballot that I think could determine whether the Republicans keep control or whether Democrats take it from them. This video explains which nine races I’m watching and shows you exactly how the Senate balance of power could flip could happen.
